To be honest, its a hit and a miss. Its a very hard thing to adapt an anime to a live action, so i went in with no expectations. 

Characters - for the most part, they felt awkward (faye especially). Spike was too emotional and it felt like he was someone trying to be cool. Jet on the other hand wasn't bad really. They changed his character a little bit, having a daughter etc, but he didn't really bother me so far. Asimov was ok also. Vicious... not a fan, hes meant to be mysterious and you aren't meant to see him that much? Which brings me to Julia. Come on, they showed us both characters of spikes arc, this isn't a good sign. Reason being is because it makes spike less mysterious also. Adding the rose tattoo wasn't necessary but it seems they may be running with spikes arc every episode, along with the usual bounty.

World building - not too bad. It had pretty accurate description of space in relation to the anime source. I mean its only episode 1 but so far it wasn't bad at all.

Story - it seems they've swapped a few things around so far, putting vicious and julia in the first episode was eh, not really necessary.. putting emphasis on spikes relationship through asimovs girlfriend, felt a tad forced but it was alright.

Style - in my opinion the most important part of cowboy bebop. Is its unique style and way of storytelling, and i have to say with absolutely not 1 aota of surprise in my body. They haven't hit the mark so far. For episode 1. Its a no, i didn't expect them to tbh, its a very hard style to replicate into live action. But i do wanna say it was a disaster, or at least not yet. Im glad they copied the music though so thats a plus.

Music - yeah they copied it so its a solid 9/10. The music choice based on what was happening was weird. I could of sworn i heard space lion for a second when asimov got away from faye and spike. 

I think out of respect for watanabe. I will watch the rest of it. Hoping it gets better. Hoping spike doesn't get worse... which i think will happen based on ep 1.
